purpose: Roll capacity, EOI, session planning, and onboarding into an advisory workforce view. Humans decide recruitment and allocation — the dashboard never auto-hires or auto-rosters.
guards: Recruitment targets are recommendations, not mandates
EOI scores prioritise review queues, not automated offers
Forecasts are planning scenarios, not guarantees of patient demand
No public earnings or percentage claims

inputs.eoiScores: priorityScore, band, hardFlags, status from Admin GP Enquiries

formulas.offeredSessions: sum over offered windows of min(activeRooms, nursingMaxSupported)
formulas.usedSessions: count of active GP assignments in offered windows
formulas.shortageSessionsHorizon: max(0, demandSessionsForecast - offeredSessions) for scenario horizon
formulas.priorityGapScore: weighted blend of full/limited windows + unfilled target sessions + onboarding lag
